name: castify
description: Search, analyze, and organize your videos in ChatGPT. Power your video needs with AI.

interface.longDescription: Castify (Screencastify) is a leading video creation and sharing platform used by 10M+ people and 2,000+ organizations. This connector gives ChatGPT access to your Castify video library, transforming your content into action-oriented AI workflows. Ask in plain language about the videos you've created or collected (any video can be added), and ChatGPT can pull views, comments, and analytics to show what videos are working and what isn't. Then act on it right away: build custom ordered playlists of related videos or organize your library into folders by subject, unit, or whatever structure fits how you teach. Because it runs inside ChatGPT, you can combine Castify with your other connected tools, like turning a playlist into a ready-to-send Gmail draft.
